blocks.text: Yeh Unit 11 (Trigonometric Functions and their Graphs) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
11.1 Domains and Ranges of Sine and Cosine Functions

blocks.prompt:
1 The domain of the function \(\sin\theta\) is:
(Function \(\sin\theta\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har real \(\theta\) ke liye unit circle par aik hi point milta hai, is liye \(\sin\theta = y\) hamesha maujood: domain \(\mathbb{R}\). \([-1, 1]\) range hai.

book_ref.quote: there is one and only one value of each

blocks.prompt:
2 The range of \(\cos\theta\) is:
(\(\cos\theta\) ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unit circle par \(-1 \le x \le 1\), yani \(-1 \le \cos\theta \le 1\); \(\pm 1\) bhi milte hain, is liye band brackets \([-1, 1]\).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the range of sine and cosine functions is

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following equations has no solution?
(In mein se kis equation ka koi hal nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Sine ki range \([-1, 1]\) hai, \(1.2\) is se bahar. Baqi teeno mumkin hain.

book_ref.quote: Use the range to spot impossible equations at once.

blocks.prompt:
4 If \(P(x, y)\) is the point where the terminal side of \(\theta\) meets the unit circle, then \(\sin\theta\) equals:
(Agar \(P(x, y)\) unit circle par \(\theta\) ki terminal side ka point ho to \(\sin\theta\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(OP = 1\): \(\sin\theta = \frac{y}{1} = y\) (aur \(\cos\theta = x\)).

book_ref.quote: Unit circle means a circle of radius 1.

blocks.prompt:
5 The smallest value of \(\sin\theta\) and the first angle in \([0, 2\pi]\) where it occurs are:
(\(\sin\theta\) ki sab se chhoti qeemat aur \([0, 2\pi]\) mein pehla angle jahan yeh aati hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin\theta = -1\) point \(D(0, -1)\) par, yani \(\theta = \frac{3\pi}{2}\). (\(\pi\) par \(\cos\theta = -1\) hai.)

book_ref.quote: Every point of the unit circle satisfies

blocks.text: 11.1.1 Domains and Ranges of Tangent and Cotangent Functions

blocks.prompt:
6 \(\tan\theta\) is undefined when \(\theta\) equals:
(\(\tan\theta\) kab undefined hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan\theta = \frac{y}{x}\) ke liye \(x \ne 0\); \(x = 0\) \(Y\)-axis par, yani \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke taaq (odd) multiples par.

book_ref.quote: A fraction has no value when its denominator is

blocks.prompt:
7 The domain of \(\cot\theta\) is:
(\(\cot\theta\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cot\theta = \frac{x}{y}\) ke liye \(y \ne 0\); \(y = 0\) at \(n\pi\). Is liye domain \(\mathbb{R} - \{n\pi\}\).

book_ref.quote: For cotangent the denominator is

blocks.prompt:
8 The range of \(\tan\theta\) is:
(\(\tan\theta\) ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan\theta\) line \(OP\) ki dhalwan (slope) hai; har real qeemat leta hai, range \(\mathbb{R}\).

book_ref.quote: there is no upper or lower limit

blocks.prompt:
9 At which of these angles is \(\cot\theta\) undefined?
(In mein se kis angle par \(\cot\theta\) undefined hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cotangent wahan fail hota hai jahan \(\sin\theta = 0\): \(0^{\circ}, 180^{\circ}, \ldots\). \(90^{\circ}\), \(270^{\circ}\) par \(\cot\theta = 0\).

book_ref.quote: A quick test: tangent fails where

blocks.prompt:
10 Which of these angles is in the domain of \(\tan\theta\)?
(In mein se kaun sa angle \(\tan\theta\) ke domain mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke taaq multiples khaarij hain; \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) un mein nahi (\(\tan\frac{3\pi}{4} = -1\)).

book_ref.quote: which is why the short form is

blocks.text: 11.1.2 Domains and Ranges of Secant Function

blocks.prompt:
11 The domain of \(\sec\theta\) is:
(\(\sec\theta\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sec\theta = \frac{1}{x}\) ke liye \(\cos\theta \ne 0\): tangent wali shart.

book_ref.quote: So secant and tangent have the same domain.

blocks.prompt:
12 The range of \(\sec\theta\) is:
(\(\sec\theta\) ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(0 < x \le 1\) par \(\frac{1}{x} \ge 1\); \(-1 \le x < 0\) par \(\frac{1}{x} \le -1\). \(\pm 1\) shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: attains all real values except those between

blocks.prompt:
13 Which of the following can be a value of \(\sec\theta\)?
(In mein se kaun si qeemat \(\sec\theta\) ki ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har \(\theta\) ke liye \(|\sec\theta| \ge 1\); \(\sec\pi = -1\). Baqi qeematein \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Remember the shape of the answer

blocks.prompt:
14 If \(\sec\theta = 2\), then \(\cos\theta\) equals:
(Agar \(\sec\theta = 2\) ho to \(\cos\theta\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sec\theta = \frac{1}{\cos\theta}\), is liye \(\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}\).

book_ref.quote: Secant has the same denominator as tangent

blocks.text: 11.1.3 Domains and Ranges of Cosecant Function

blocks.prompt:
15 The domain of \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) is:
(\(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta = \frac{1}{y}\) ke liye \(\sin\theta \ne 0\), yani \(\theta \ne n\pi\).

book_ref.quote: so cosecant and cotangent have the same domain

blocks.prompt:
16 The range of \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) is:
(\(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf khula interval \((-1, 1)\) khaarij hai, kyunke \(\operatorname{cosec}\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\) aur \(\operatorname{cosec}\frac{3\pi}{2} = -1\).

book_ref.quote: attains all values except those between

blocks.prompt:
17 Which pair of functions has the same domain?
(Kaun se do functions ka domain aik jaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan x\) aur \(\sec x\) dono ka denominator \(\cos x\) hai, dono \((2n + 1)\frac{\pi}{2}\) khaarij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The table is easy to remember in three pairs

blocks.prompt:
18 Which number is NOT a value of \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\)?
(Kaun sa number \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta\) ki qeemat nahi ho sakta?)
blocks.explanation: \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta = \frac{1}{3}\) ke liye \(\sin\theta = 3\) chahiye, jo mumkin nahi. \(3\) ke liye \(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{3}\), mumkin.

book_ref.quote: Only the open interval \((-1, 1)\) is removed

blocks.prompt:
19 A function \(f\) is even if, for every \(x\) in its domain:
(Function \(f\) even kab hota hai (domain ke har \(x\) ke liye)?)
blocks.explanation: Even: \(f(-x) = f(x)\); odd: \(f(-x) = -f(x)\). \(f(x + 2\pi) = f(x)\) periodicity hai.

book_ref.quote: A function \(f\) is said to be even if

blocks.prompt:
20 The graph of an odd function is always symmetric about:
(Odd function ka graph hamesha kis ke gird symmetric hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Odd function mein \((x, f(x))\) aur \((-x, -f(x))\) dono graph par, is liye origin ke gird symmetry.

book_ref.quote: The graph of an odd function is always symmetric about the origin.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which of the following is an even function?
(In mein se kaun sa even function hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\), cosine even hai; baqi teeno odd hain.

book_ref.quote: is an even function (see figure 9.2)

blocks.prompt:
22 The function \(f(x) = x\sin x\) is:
(Function \(f(x) = x\sin x\) kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(-x) = (-x)(-\sin x) = x\sin x = f(x)\): even.

book_ref.quote: To decide whether a function is even, odd or neither

blocks.prompt:
23 The function \(f(x) = \sin x\cos x\) is:
(Function \(f(x) = \sin x\cos x\) kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(-x) = (-\sin x)\cos x = -f(x)\): odd.

book_ref.quote: Odd means: changing the sign of the input changes only the sign of the output.

blocks.prompt:
24 The function \(f(x) = x + \cos x\) is:
(Function \(f(x) = x + \cos x\) kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(-x) = -x + \cos x\), jo na \(f(x)\) hai na \(-f(x)\). Is liye na even na odd.

book_ref.quote: Most functions are neither.

blocks.prompt:
25 For a function to be tested for even or odd, its domain must have the property:
(Even/odd jaanchne ke liye function ke domain ki kya khoobi zaroori hai?)

options.text: jab \(x\) domain mein ho to \(-x\) bhi ho
domain mein sirf musbat numbers hon

blocks.explanation: Test mein \(f(x)\) aur \(f(-x)\) ka muqabla hota hai, is liye \(x\) ke saath \(-x\) bhi domain mein ho. Poora \(\mathbb{R}\) zaroori nahi, maslan \(\tan x\).

book_ref.quote: must also be in the domain of

blocks.prompt:
26 The period of \(\tan\theta\) is:
(\(\tan\theta\) ka period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan(\theta + \pi) = \tan\theta\), aur \(\pi\) sab se chhota musbat number hai. \(2\pi\) bhi dohrata hai magar sab se chhota nahi.

book_ref.quote: Tangent is a periodic function and its period is

blocks.prompt:
27 The period of \(\sin 4x\) is:
(\(\sin 4x\) ka period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 4\left(x + \frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \sin 4x\), is liye period \(\frac{2\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2}\).

book_ref.quote: rewrite the shifted angle

blocks.prompt:
28 The period of \(\cot 3x\) is:
(\(\cot 3x\) ka period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cot\) ka period \(\pi\), is liye \(\cot 3x\) ka period \(\frac{\pi}{3}\).

book_ref.quote: A quick rule that follows from Example 1

blocks.prompt:
29 The period of \(5 + \cos\frac{x}{4}\) is:
(\(5 + \cos\frac{x}{4}\) ka period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos\frac{1}{4}(x + 8\pi) = \cos\frac{x}{4}\); constant 5 period nahi badalta: \(8\pi\).

book_ref.quote: Adding a constant does not change the period.

blocks.prompt:
30 A function \(f\) has period \(p\) if \(f(\theta + p) = f(\theta)\) for all \(\theta\) in its domain and \(p\) is:
(Function \(f\) ka period \(p\) tab hai jab har \(\theta\) ke liye \(f(\theta + p) = f(\theta)\) ho aur \(p\):)

options.text: aisa sab se chhota musbat number

blocks.explanation: Period sab se chhota musbat \(p\) hai; maslan \(2\pi, 4\pi\) dono sine dohrate hain, magar period \(2\pi\) hai.

book_ref.quote: and the least positive value of

blocks.prompt:
31 \(\pi\) is not the period of \(\sin\theta\) because:
(\(\pi\) \(\sin\theta\) ka period kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Aadha chakkar sine ka nishan badal deta hai: \(\sin(\pi + \theta) = -\sin\theta\).

book_ref.quote: One counter-example is enough to reject

blocks.prompt:
32 The period of \(\sec\theta\) is:
(\(\sec\theta\) ka period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos\theta\), \(\csc\theta\), \(\sec\theta\) ka period \(2\pi\); \(\tan\theta\), \(\cot\theta\) ka \(\pi\).

book_ref.quote: By adopting the procedure used in finding the periods of sine and tangent

blocks.prompt:
33 The period of \(\cos\frac{2x}{3}\) is:
(\(\cos\frac{2x}{3}\) ka period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{2\pi}{2/3} = 3\pi\). Check: \(\cos\left(\frac{2x}{3} + 2\pi\right) = \cos\frac{2x}{3}\).

book_ref.quote: runs twice as fast, so the period is halved

blocks.prompt:
34 \(\sin 210^{\circ}\) equals:
(\(\sin 210^{\circ}\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin(180^{\circ} + 30^{\circ}) = -\sin 30^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\) (teesra quadrant).

book_ref.quote: where only tangent is positive

blocks.prompt:
35 \(\cos 300^{\circ}\) equals:
(\(\cos 300^{\circ}\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos(360^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}) = \cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\) (chautha quadrant).

book_ref.quote: where only cosine is positive

blocks.prompt:
36 \(\tan 135^{\circ}\) equals:
(\(\tan 135^{\circ}\) kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: where only sine is positive

blocks.prompt:
37 \(\cos(-120^{\circ})\) equals:
(\(\cos(-120^{\circ})\) kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: Forgetting the outer minus sign for negative angles

blocks.prompt:
38 \(\sin(-225^{\circ})\) equals:
(\(\sin(-225^{\circ})\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(-\sin 225^{\circ} = -(-\sin 45^{\circ}) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\); do minus mil kar plus.

book_ref.quote: two minus signs make a plus

blocks.prompt:
39 \(\tan 330^{\circ}\) equals:
(\(\tan 330^{\circ}\) kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: The sign follows the quadrant of the angle.

blocks.prompt:
40 \(\cos(\pi - \theta)\) equals:
(\(\cos(\pi - \theta)\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\pi - \theta\) doosre quadrant mein, jahan cosine manfi: \(\cos(\pi - \theta) = -\cos\theta\).

book_ref.quote: the cosine of an angle in Quadrant II is negative

blocks.prompt:
41 In drawing the graph of a trigonometric function, the measures of the angles are taken along:
(Trigonometric function ka graph banate waqt angles kis axis par liye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Angles \(X\)-axis par aur function ki qeematein \(Y\)-axis par.

book_ref.quote: The measures of the angles are taken along the

blocks.prompt:
42 The plotted points of a trigonometric graph are joined by:
(Trigonometric graph ke points kaise milaye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Qeematein points ke darmiyan aahista badalti hain, is liye aik hamwaar (smooth) curve se milate hain.

book_ref.quote: These points are joined with the help of smooth curves.

blocks.prompt:
43 The \(X\)-axis mark \(240^{\circ}\) in radians is:
(\(X\)-axis ka nishan \(240^{\circ}\) radians mein:)

book_ref.quote: every degree mark has a radian name

blocks.text: 11.4.2 Graph of y = sin x from - 2pi to 2pi

blocks.prompt:
44 The maximum value of \(y = \sin x\) occurs at:
(\(y = \sin x\) ki zyada se zyada qeemat kahan aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x = 1\), \(\frac{\pi}{2} + 2n\pi\) par. \(\frac{3\pi}{2} + 2n\pi\) par minimum \(-1\).

book_ref.quote: When asked for the maximum or minimum of

blocks.prompt:
45 In \([-2\pi, 2\pi]\), the graph of \(y = \sin x\) cuts the \(x\)-axis at how many points?
(\([-2\pi, 2\pi]\) mein \(y = \sin x\) ka graph \(x\)-axis ko kitne points par kat'ta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zeros \(x = n\pi\): \(-2\pi, -\pi, 0, \pi, 2\pi\), yani 5 points.

book_ref.quote: exactly where the curve cuts the

blocks.prompt:
46 The \(y\)-intercept of the graph of \(y = \sin x\) is:
(\(y = \sin x\) ke graph ka \(y\)-intercept kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 0 = 0\): sine graph origin se guzarta hai.

book_ref.quote: Sine starts at the origin.

blocks.prompt:
47 The graph of \(y = \sin x\) is symmetric about:
(\(y = \sin x\) ka graph kis ke gird symmetric hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\): sine odd hai, graph origin ke gird symmetric.

book_ref.quote: The sine function is an odd function.

blocks.prompt:
48 The part of the sine graph over one period, \([0, 2\pi]\), is called:
(Sine graph ka aik period \([0, 2\pi]\) wala hissa kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: \([0, 2\pi]\) wala graph aik cycle (chakkar) kehlata hai; poora graph har \(2\pi\) baad dohrata hai.

book_ref.quote: is called a cycle. Since the period of sine function is

blocks.prompt:
49 For \(180^{\circ} < x < 360^{\circ}\), the graph of \(y = \sin x\) lies:
(\(180^{\circ} < x < 360^{\circ}\) ke liye \(y = \sin x\) ka graph kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teesre aur chauthe quadrant mein sine manfi, is liye curve \(x\)-axis ke neeche.

book_ref.quote: The curve is positive in Quadrants I and II and negative in Quadrants III and IV

blocks.text: 11.4.3 Graph of y = cos x from - 2pi to 2pi

blocks.prompt:
50 The minimum value of \(y = \cos x\) and where it occurs are:
(\(y = \cos x\) ki kam se kam qeemat aur kahan aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = -1\) \(\pi\) ke taaq multiples par, maslan \(\cos 180^{\circ} = -1\).

book_ref.quote: Copying the misprint: the minimum of

blocks.prompt:
51 The \(y\)-intercept of the graph of \(y = \cos x\) is:
(\(y = \cos x\) ke graph ka \(y\)-intercept kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos 0 = 1\): cosine graph \((0, 1)\) se shuru hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The cosine curve starts at its highest point

blocks.prompt:
52 The \(x\)-intercepts of \(y = \cos x\) are at:
(\(y = \cos x\) ke \(x\)-intercepts kahan hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = 0\), \(\frac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\) par. \(n\pi\) sine ke zeros hain.

book_ref.quote: Putting the zeros of cosine at

blocks.prompt:
53 The graph of \(y = \cos x\) is symmetric about:
(\(y = \cos x\) ka graph kis ke gird symmetric hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\): cosine even hai, graph \(y\)-axis ke gird symmetric.

book_ref.quote: The cosine function is an even function, as the graph

blocks.prompt:
54 The graph of y = cos x is the graph of y = sin x moved:
(y = cos x ka graph, y = sin x ke graph ko kitna aur kis taraf khiskane se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = \sin(x + 90^{\circ})\): graph \(90^{\circ}\) baayen taraf khisakta hai.

book_ref.quote: so the cosine graph is the sine graph moved

blocks.prompt:
55 The amplitude of \(y = \cos x\) is:
(\(y = \cos x\) ka amplitude kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peak \(x\)-axis se \(1\) upar: amplitude \(= \frac{1 - (-1)}{2} = 1\).

book_ref.quote: Same shape as sine, moved

blocks.text: 11.4.4 Graph of y = tan x from -pi to pi

blocks.prompt:
56 The vertical asymptotes of the graph of \(y = \tan x\) are the lines:
(\(y = \tan x\) ke graph ke vertical asymptotes kaun si lines hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan x\), \(x = (2n + 1)\frac{\pi}{2}\) par undefined; curve in lines ke qareeb jata hai magar chhoota nahi.

book_ref.quote: is called an asymptote and is drawn dashed

blocks.prompt:
57 As \(x\) approaches \(90^{\circ}\) from the right (e.g. \(91^{\circ}\)), \(\tan x\):
(Jab \(x\) daayen taraf se \(90^{\circ}\) ke qareeb aaye (maslan \(91^{\circ}\)), \(\tan x\):)
blocks.explanation: \(90^{\circ}\) ke daayen angle doosre quadrant mein, tangent manfi: \(\tan 91^{\circ} \approx -57.3\), \(\tan x \to -\infty\).

book_ref.quote: dividing by a very small number gives a very large answer

blocks.prompt:
58 The amplitude of \(y = \tan x\) is:
(\(y = \tan x\) ka amplitude kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan x\) ki koi maximum ya minimum qeemat nahi, is liye amplitude undefined.

book_ref.quote: The amplitude of tangent function is undefined because it has no maximum or minimum values.

blocks.prompt:
59 The \(x\)-intercepts of \(y = \tan x\) are at:
(\(y = \tan x\) ke \(x\)-intercepts kahan hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan x = 0\) jahan \(\sin x = 0\): \(x = n\pi\). \((2n + 1)\frac{\pi}{2}\) asymptotes hain.

book_ref.quote: the graph passes through the origin; odd function

blocks.prompt:
60 On every interval between two consecutive asymptotes, \(\tan x\):
(Do lagataar asymptotes ke darmiyan har interval par \(\tan x\):)
blocks.explanation: Har branch baayen se daayen upar jati hai: \(-\infty\) se \(+\infty\) tak.

book_ref.quote: Each branch rises from left to right

blocks.text: 11.5 Maximum and Minimum Values of Given Functions of the Type a + b sin theta, a + b cos theta, a + b sin(c theta + d), a + b cos(c theta + d) and reciprocals

blocks.prompt:
61 The maximum value of \(4 + 3\sin x\) is:
(\(4 + 3\sin x\) ki zyada se zyada qeemat kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Thus the maximum value of

blocks.prompt:
62 The minimum value of \(6 - 5\cos 2x\) is:
(\(6 - 5\cos 2x\) ki kam se kam qeemat kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: For any question of this section write three things first

blocks.prompt:
63 The amplitude of \(-7 + 2\sin(3x - 1)\) is:
(\(-7 + 2\sin(3x - 1)\) ka amplitude kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude \(= |b| = 2\); \(-7\) vertical shift aur 3 period badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: the maximum height of the wave measured from its midline

blocks.prompt:
64 The period of \(3 + 2\sin(4\theta + 1)\) is:
(\(3 + 2\sin(4\theta + 1)\) ka period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period \(= \frac{2\pi}{c} = \frac{2\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2}\).

book_ref.quote: Period: the period of (i) is equal to

blocks.prompt:
65 The maximum value of \(\dfrac{1}{4 - \cos x}\) is:
(\(\dfrac{1}{4 - \cos x}\) ki zyada se zyada qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(4 - \cos x\) ki qeemat \(3\) se \(5\); denominator sab se chhota ho to fraction sab se bara: \(\frac{1}{3}\).

book_ref.quote: For a positive reciprocal

blocks.prompt:
66 The maximum value of \(2 - 4\cos x\) occurs when:
(\(2 - 4\cos x\) ki zyada se zyada qeemat kab aati hai?)

book_ref.quote: but the conditions printed with them hold only when

blocks.prompt:
67 A sinusoidal function has maximum value 9 and minimum value 1. Its amplitude is:
(Aik sinusoidal function ki maximum qeemat 9 aur minimum 1 hai. Amplitude kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude \(= \frac{9 - 1}{2} = 4\) (midline \(5\)).

book_ref.quote: The value of the amplitude can also be found using the formula

blocks.prompt:
68 In \(f(\theta) = a + b\sin(c\theta + d)\), the midline of the wave is:
(\(f(\theta) = a + b\sin(c\theta + d)\) mein wave ki midline kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(a\) vertical shift hai; \(y = a\) midline hai.

book_ref.quote: This shift, also known as the vertical displacement

blocks.prompt:
69 Compared with \(y = \sin\theta\), the graph of \(y = \sin(\theta + d)\) with \(d > 0\) is shifted:
(\(y = \sin\theta\) ke muqable mein \(y = \sin(\theta + d)\) (\(d > 0\)) ka graph kis taraf khisakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Musbat \(d\) graph ko baayen khiskata hai (\(c = 1\), is liye faasla \(d\)).

book_ref.quote: shifts the graph to the left, while a negative

blocks.prompt:
70 A Ferris wheel has radius 20 ft and its lowest point is 3 ft above the ground. The midline (height of the centre) of its height model is:
(Ferris wheel ka radius 20 ft aur sab se neecha point zameen se 3 ft upar hai. Height model ki midline (markaz ki unchai) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude = radius = 20; markaz \(a = 3 + 20 = 23\) ft. (Sab se upar \(43\) ft.)

book_ref.quote: the radius gives the amplitude

blocks.prompt:
71 A wheel makes one revolution in 40 seconds. In \(h(t) = a - b\cos(ct)\), the value of \(c\) is:
(Wheel 40 seconds mein aik chakkar lagata hai. \(h(t) = a - b\cos(ct)\) mein \(c\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{2\pi}{c} = 40 \Rightarrow c = \frac{\pi}{20}\).

book_ref.quote: after one revolution the rider is back at the same height

blocks.prompt:
72 A rider starts at the lowest point of a wheel. Which model fits (a = height of centre, b = radius)?
(Sawaar wheel ke sab se neechay point se shuru karta hai. Kaun sa model theek hai (a = markaz ki unchai, b = radius)?)
blocks.explanation: \(t = 0\) par \(a - b\) sab se neechi unchai. \(a + b\cos\) upar se, \(a + b\sin\) midline se shuru hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Choosing the starting function

blocks.prompt:
73 The water level of a river is \(L(t) = 10 + 3\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}t\right)\) feet, \(t\) in hours. The period of the level is:
(Darya ki satah \(L(t) = 10 + 3\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}t\right)\) feet hai (\(t\) ghanton mein). Period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Period \(= \frac{2\pi}{\pi/4} = 8\) ghante.

(Aik choti jheel ki satah se h metre upar hai. Paani mein us ka aks kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thehre paani mein aks utna hi neeche hota hai jitna cheez upar hai.

book_ref.quote: the image is as far below the water surface as the object is above it
